evidence.reason: I1's JSON-on-stdout/narration-on-stderr contract (item 2) governs the cq ops CLI commands and their machine mode (`--json`); `apps/crq-python/ops/prepare-host.py` is a human-run host deployment helper (invoked per HOST-DEPLOY.md) with subcommands live-config/prepare/preview/switch/legacy-check, not a cq op and not a machine-mode command. Its single `print` of an operator-facing completion line is existing intended behavior, and the finding supplies no evidence of any live consumer parsing its stdout as JSON. Requiring this helper to adopt the --json/stdout-JSON artifact is a proposal to enlarge the output contract to a deployment script, not an implementation defect in existing required behavior. The cited `import sys` scoping note is accurate but moot because the underlying requirement does not apply here.
